answer: A claim must carry its nadir. Every real job has a hardest point where honest work stumbles and retries, so the claimant posts its failure log for five cents; a lotus warden reads it within an hour and checks one failed attempt against the sealed reference. A voyage with no stumble is a flat voyage: claim void, fee burned, barred a week. Honest work costs five cents and one stumble; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and must stage 1,000 believable failures.
